doc.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

title: Photo of Tom's band with Joe Frisco; Al Capone and the trombone case
summary: Identifying musicians in a photograph (Ray Lopez, Billy Lambert, Larry Shields) and confirming the story that Al Capone held Tom's trombone case at a Chicago prize fight.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: He's just got tons of it here. Yes. Pictures all over the place. Various bands he's played with. Well, right in front of me I can see Frisco dancing. And there's Tom in the background playing trombone and on the bass. Ray Lopez it looks like on cornet. On cornet, Ray, yes. And is that Billy Lambert?
And the clarinet play I'm not sure of.
I think it's Larry or Harry. Larry.
It's Larry would be the one in Chicago. Harry was still young then.
Because I get them mixed up to see.
Those two. And as mentioned in the article in the record changer, Al Capone is holding Tom's trombone case right there. You can see him in the car.
And then, let's see, what does the article say? We once played for a prize fight in Chicago and Al Capone held my trombone case. I have a picture of that.
